# graviteeam_org_settings (Resource)

Manages Gravitee AM organization settings (singleton resource)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_org_settings" "example" {
  identities = [graviteeam_org_identity_provider.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identities` (List of String) List of identity provider IDs to activate at the organization level

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for the settings resource (always "settings")
